title: VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities at Angul Smelter Plant
scope_summary: Development and commissioning of an enterprise-grade AR/VR training solution for safety, operations, and maintenance activities at NALCO's Angul Smelter Plant. The solution must include hardware, software, and integration services for immersive training in critical plant areas such as Pot Room activities, anode change processes, and emergency workflows.

title: RFP for 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per MHA QRs
tendering_authority: Department Of Electronics And Information Technology
scope_summary: Procurement of a 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) Quality Requirements (QRs). This is a product bid with a quantity of 1 set for delivery to Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka.

title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects - AI-Enabled CBME-Aligned Integrated Academics Management System
scope_summary: Hiring an agency for IT projects, specifically for an AI-enabled CBME-aligned Integrated Academics Management System. The project involves a quantity of 1 unit.

title: Supply, Installation and Operationalization of 3D Virtual Reality System
scope_summary: Open tender for the supply, installation, and operationalization of a 3D Virtual Reality System along with a 3-year comprehensive onsite warranty and subsequent annual maintenance contracts for 4 years.

title: Business Intelligence and Data Analysis Software (V2)
scope_summary: Tender invited for Business Intelligence and Data Analysis Software (V2) for Municipal Corporations Mumbai. The tender specifies a quantity of 1 unit.

title: Tender for Designing Software (V3) in KHORDHA, ODISHA
tendering_authority: Chief Engineer(dpi&roads), eic(civil), R&b, Orissa, Bhubaneswar
scope_summary: Public tender for Designing Software (V3) for infrastructure projects in Khordha, Odisha. The software should include features like site planning, road and bridge design, earthwork calculation, terrain modeling, drainage and water network design, clash detection, pavement design, utility network design, and traffic simulation.

title: RFP for AI-Powered GIS And Digital Twin Deployment in DISCOMs
tendering_authority: International Solar Alliance (ISA) and Ajmer Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (AVVNL)
scope_summary: Request for Proposal for the appointment of System Integrators (SIs) to implement an advanced AI-powered digital transformation project for power distribution companies (DISCOMs). The project aims to strengthen Distributed Energy Resources (DER) integration through GIS-based Asset Management, Network Analysis, and Load Forecasting solutions, including the creation of digital twins.

title: Service Rate Contract for IIOT Vibration Monitoring System
scope_summary: Service rate contract for the implementation of an IIoT Vibration Monitoring System at Bokaro, Jharkhand, India. The project focuses on equipment health monitoring and predictive maintenance.
